dataset: Izmir Urban Resilience & Essential Services Atlas
interpretation_guards: Zero source records are not proof that a real-world service does not exist.
Transit distances are straight-line proxies from neighborhood representative points, not walking times.
Per-capita metrics describe source-record capacity context; they are not quality, safety, welfare or investment scores.
Population growth uses the official TUIK continuous per-mille rate; it is not a simple percent-change field.
No district ranking or composite resilience score is published.
